Compute the state vector at all time points t_n = 0.0 + n*dt for n = 0 to 5000.
Save the file solution_molk_006.npz containing arrays t of shape (5001,), Y of shape (5001, 3) with columns ordered as [E, I, H], and the scalar parameters alpha, beta, gamma, delta, epsilon, theta, phi.
Save line plots of E versus t, I versus t, and H versus t in solution_molk_006.png.
